subject: olm salamander
title: A Blind Cave Salamander Can Live Past 100 by Barely Moving

scenes.text: This blind salamander can outlive you.
The olm lives in dark European caves. A study of a 400 animal colony predicts a maximum lifespan over one hundred years.
Its secret is doing almost nothing. One tagged olm seemed to stay in the same spot for seven years.
It eats about once a month and can go a year without food.
It even breeds only about every twelve years.
Slow, still and blind, and still here. So yes, it can outlive you.

description:
The olm is a blind cave salamander that can live past one hundred years.
One tagged olm barely moved for seven years, and olms eat about once a month.
Would you trade a fast life for a slow one that long? Comment below.
first_comment: An olm in a cave hardly moved for seven years. Would you live that slowly for 100 years?
